content: GitHub Pages has no server runtime and no rewrite rules. For a Vite React SPA: set vite base to '/<repo>/'; deploy via GitHub Actions (checkout v7, setup-node v7, configure-pages v6, upload-pages-artifact v5 path ./dist, deploy-pages v5). SPA deep links 404 unless you copy dist/index.html to dist/404.html in the build step (simplest), or use the rafgraph 404-redirect script, or switch to HashRouter. Actions flow does not run Jekyll so .nojekyll is unnecessary (needed only for gh-pages branch deploys). Deep links return HTTP 404 status — fine for an auth-gated app, not for SEO.
